entries.explanation: Defines Act 1 route graph, node sequencing, encounter IDs, reward pools, and referenced data files.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep node IDs and next references consistent; update floor, type, and referenced pool or encounter IDs together.
entries.modification_impact: Changes map progression, encounter selection, rewards, and which data files the runtime loads.

entries.explanation: Defines Act 1 enemies, categories, combat statistics, and available intent pools.
entries.parameter_guidance: Adjust hp, attack, defense, and intent pool IDs per enemy; preserve unique enemy IDs referenced by encounters.
entries.modification_impact: Changes enemy strength, classification, and possible combat behaviors.

entries.explanation: Defines card identity, localization keys, cost, type, target, rarity, effects, and upgrade routes.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep card IDs and localization keys stable; ensure effect fields match the card type and upgrade route structure.
entries.modification_impact: Changes card availability, costs, combat effects, displayed text, and upgrade outcomes.

entries.explanation: Defines card reward pools by encounter type, rarity, offer count, and card IDs.
entries.parameter_guidance: Use card IDs present in card definitions and keep pool IDs aligned with reward-pool references.
entries.modification_impact: Changes which cards can appear as combat or event rewards and how many choices are offered.

entries.explanation: Defines curse identity, localization keys, removability, and base effects.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep curse IDs referenced by cards and events; change removability and effect flags deliberately.
entries.modification_impact: Changes curse behavior, draw effects, and whether players can remove the curse.

entries.explanation: Defines combat-state enemy intents, icons, text keys, and timed effects.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep enemy IDs aligned with enemy definitions; ensure effect kinds, amounts, timing, and targets form valid combinations.
entries.modification_impact: Changes enemy previews and the effects executed on player or enemy turns.

entries.explanation: Defines event titles, descriptions, options, previews, feedback keys, effects, and return routes.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve unique event and option IDs; keep effect-specific fields and localization keys synchronized.
entries.modification_impact: Changes event choices, costs or gains, curses, feedback, and post-event navigation.

entries.explanation: Defines relic metadata, trigger timing, execution boundaries, parameters, and tags.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep relic IDs and trigger paths stable; modify numeric parameters within the expected effect contract.
entries.modification_impact: Changes passive combat or shop modifiers and relic-related UI attribution.

entries.explanation: Defines rest-site options, labels, confirmations, feedback, and effects such as healing or upgrades.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep option IDs unique; preserve required-target and irreversible flags when changing effects.
entries.modification_impact: Changes healing amounts, card upgrades, curse removal, confirmation flow, and rest-site outcomes.

entries.explanation: Defines reward bundles containing gold, consumables, relics, and card-choice pools.
entries.parameter_guidance: Reference existing pool, card, relic, and consumable IDs; keep pick counts and availability states coherent.
entries.modification_impact: Changes post-encounter rewards, card choices, gold, and fallback behavior.

entries.explanation: Defines shop offers, prices, services, allowed targets, and blocked feedback keys.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep offer and service IDs unique; ensure card, relic, and target references resolve to defined resources.
entries.modification_impact: Changes shop inventory, prices, purchasability, services, and error feedback.

entries.explanation: Defines the Warrior starting deck, card counts, character identity, and shuffle configuration.
entries.parameter_guidance: Use valid card IDs and nonnegative counts; preserve deck and character IDs expected by loaders.
entries.modification_impact: Changes the initial draw pool, deck composition, and shuffle randomness source.

entries.explanation: Provides English localized strings consumed by combat, map, reward, shop, event, and HUD screens.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep localization keys stable and maintain the CSV schema expected by translation loaders.
entries.modification_impact: Changes English UI text, feedback, labels, and accessibility-visible wording.

entries.explanation: Provides Simplified Chinese localized strings for the same runtime UI flows.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep keys aligned with the English catalog and preserve valid CSV quoting and columns.
entries.modification_impact: Changes Simplified Chinese UI text, feedback, labels, and displayed combat information.

entries.explanation: Card texture loaded for runtime presentation in the Godot combat flow.
entries.parameter_guidance: Replace the image while preserving the path and a compatible readable format and size.
entries.modification_impact: Changes the card artwork shown in runtime UI and related visual checks.

entries.explanation: Enemy target artwork referenced by combat scene rendering.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve the path and image compatibility expected by TextureRect or runtime loaders.
entries.modification_impact: Changes the displayed enemy target visual without changing combat data.

entries.explanation: Slime enemy artwork used by combat scene presentation.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep the asset path and compatible texture format so runtime loading continues to succeed.
entries.modification_impact: Changes the slime enemy appearance in combat UI.

entries.explanation: Defines the combat scene UI hierarchy, HUD controls, overlays, pile viewer, map overlay, and visual layout.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve node paths consumed by CombatScene.cs and keep control types compatible with script bindings.
entries.modification_impact: Changes combat layout, visibility, interaction surfaces, overlays, and scene wiring.

entries.explanation: Defines the map scene route display, node buttons, edge labels, legends, and action controls.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep node names and paths aligned with MapScene.cs; update labels and layout values consistently.
entries.modification_impact: Changes map presentation, route navigation controls, and visible progression structure.

entries.explanation: Contract resource associated with the combat HUD snapshot exchanged between domain and UI layers.
entries.parameter_guidance: Treat fields as a stable BCL-only contract; coordinate any shape changes with consumers and tests.
entries.modification_impact: Changes the data available for combat HUD rendering and may require adapter updates.

entries.explanation: Defines event-type contract values used to classify or route combat events.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve serialized or referenced names unless all consumers are updated together.
entries.modification_impact: Changes event classification and routing decisions across combat systems.

entries.explanation: Contract for publishing resolved combat damage information.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep payload fields compatible with event publishers, subscribers, and serialization expectations.
entries.modification_impact: Changes how damage resolution is reported to UI and other systems.

entries.explanation: Contract signaling that a combat encounter has ended.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve outcome fields and event identity expected by navigation and reward flows.
entries.modification_impact: Changes combat completion handling, reward transitions, and scene navigation triggers.

entries.explanation: Contract signaling the beginning of a combat encounter.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep start-context fields aligned with combat initialization consumers.
entries.modification_impact: Changes initialization data available when entering combat.

entries.explanation: Event contract for dispatching combat-start notifications.
entries.parameter_guidance: Coordinate payload changes with event buses, adapters, and Godot listeners.
entries.modification_impact: Changes combat-start notification behavior and UI initialization timing.

entries.explanation: Event contract signaling the start of a combat turn.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve turn index, actor, and state fields expected by HUD updates and intent handling.
entries.modification_impact: Changes turn-state refreshes, energy or draw updates, and intent presentation timing.

entries.explanation: Event contract for recording or broadcasting a selected enemy intent.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep intent and enemy identifiers resolvable against intent-definition data.
entries.modification_impact: Changes intent display, combat planning feedback, and downstream intent processing.

entries.explanation: Domain service associated with deck construction, shuffling, and card-pile operations.
entries.parameter_guidance: Maintain deterministic RNG and contract invariants when changing deck behavior.
entries.modification_impact: Changes draw, discard, exhaust, and deck composition behavior during runs.

entries.explanation: Godot combat UI controller that loads data, binds HUD nodes, and coordinates combat presentation.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep referenced scene node paths and data file paths synchronized with scene and config resources.
entries.modification_impact: Changes combat UI behavior, input handling, data binding, visuals, and navigation.

entries.explanation: Shared HUD controller associated with player status and combat interface updates.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve exported or looked-up node names used by scene scripts.
entries.modification_impact: Changes status display, counters, labels, and shared HUD interactions.

entries.explanation: Map UI controller that loads route data and wires map nodes and navigation actions.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep scene node paths and route identifiers aligned with act configuration.
entries.modification_impact: Changes map rendering, node selection, route transitions, and map feedback.

entries.explanation: Godot test-support bridge exposing deck-service behavior to task-specific integration tests.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep bridge signatures synchronized with DeckService and test expectations.
entries.modification_impact: Changes test-time access to deck operations and may affect integration-test setup.
